create_blip2processor: create a Blip2Processor instance with an image processor, tokenizer, and optional num_query_tokens
call_blip2processor_text_only: call Blip2Processor with text input to tokenize and encode text strings into BatchEncoding
call_blip2processor_images_only: call Blip2Processor with image input to process and encode images into pixel_values
call_blip2processor_text_and_images: call Blip2Processor with both images and text to prepend image tokens and encode multimodal input
configure_blip2processor_kwargs: configure Blip2ProcessorKwargs with text_kwargs options like padding, max_length, and return_tensors
